title: Founded online gaming company Shanda with family members in 1999
statement: Founded online gaming company Shanda with family members in 1999.
outcome: Shanda became China's largest internet company by market capitalization in 2004, with three subsidiaries eventually listed on NASDAQ and one on KOSDAQ.

title: Took Shanda's parent company private in early 2012
statement: Took Shanda's parent company private in early 2012.
outcome: Shanda Group operates today as a family-owned global investment company under Chen's continued leadership as founder, chairman and CEO.

title: Committed $1 billion in late 2016 to found the Tianqiao and Chrissy
statement: Committed $1 billion in late 2016 to found the Tianqiao and Chrissy Chen Institute for brain science research.
outcome: The Chen Institute established Chen Frontier Labs and has funded programs supporting young scientists and brain-focused conferences globally, per Shanda's own team page.
